extended address

  • CURIE: gmeow:extendedAddress
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/extendedAddress
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/contacts
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The extended-address coordinate value of a postal address, expressed along the gmeow:axisExtendedAddress axis of the postal reference frame.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:PostalAddress -> rdfs:Literal

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:extendedAddress from gmeow:PostalAddress to rdfs:Literal when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

gmeow:PostalAddress

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for the secondary address line — suite, unit, apartment, or floor — that refines the street line within the same premises.

Avoid when

  • Avoid folding it into gmeow:streetAddress when a source keeps them apart, and avoid using it for a post-office box (that is gmeow:postOfficeBox).

How to use

  • Carry the secondary line as written; it inherits the address's personal sensitivity and coarsens with it under a public projection.

Examples

  • ex:home gmeow:extendedAddress "Suite 4B".

Avoid For Consumers

  • gmeow:consumerPublicSite
  • gmeow:consumerWikidata
